description: This Java class defines an Akka actor called RetrieveConnectionMetricsAggregatorActor, which aggregates multiple RetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse messages related to a specific network connection. It listens for responses, manages timeouts, aggregates responses as they arrive, and sends a consolidated response back to the original requester.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionMetricsAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that aggregates responses of type RetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse received from multiple sources related to a specific connection, manages timeouts, and sends a consolidated response when all expected responses are received.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns a Props configuration object for creating an instance of RetrieveConnectionMetricsAggregatorActor with provided parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, specifying how to process incoming messages.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles the case when a receive timeout occurs, sending an exception if no response has been aggregated.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes setting a receive timeout before the actor starts processing messages.

methods.name: handleRetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming RetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse messages, aggregating them or triggering response sending if all responses are received.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends the aggregated response back to the original requester.
